results.name: Reader view in a Private proxy tab (PR-07k): pypi.org/help/ as Fusion's reader page — article text, title and reading time, no script but the runtime, opaque origin, nothing contacted but Fusion; find works in the reader; an in-article link stays in the reader with the address following; Back; 'Original page' leaves the reader and the Reader button follows; Reader off returns to the normal page

reader endpoint headers (PR-07k): the reader page is served with a CSP sandbox (no same-origin), scripts only from Fusion (no inline script), no forms; a non-page address gets a plain refusal; a private address is refused (SSRF)

named profiles (PR-07o): two tabs in profile Work share one session and its cookies, a third tab on the same site (this tab only) does not; switching it to Work joins the jar, switching a Work tab to 'this tab only' leaves it; the profile is saved with the window; closing the last Work tab deletes the Work session
